item.description:
Show what is left instead of what is used, a Dock style, oMLX, and Claude and Codex on your own servers.

  • Show remaining instead of used: rings and figures count down what is left, can shut when a window is spent, and can order themselves by what remains.
  • Remote hosts and Muse: Claude and Codex accounts on servers you reach over SSH, and Muse.
  • A Dock style: the notch floats just clear of the screen's edge.
  • oMLX: loaded models, phase and queue, speed, context fill and a daily token count.
  • Breathing working indicator, optional, in the provider's colour.
  • Enterprise spend forecast: whether the monthly limit lasts until it resets.
  • OpenCode activity on Custom Endpoints, Grok Bot's weekly usage, DeepSeek off-peak on Chinese public holidays, gentler Claude retries, notches back on external displays after sleep.
  • Windows: the notch folds over full-screen apps, Enterprise spend limits, configs saved with a byte-order mark, no stale Claude arcs after a failed sign-in, and the Z.AI key from GLM_API_KEY.
